name: SWEEP-S6v2 Roommates
_design: One meaningful interaction, four times over: 8 identical agents start as 4 pairs, each pair on one point with one tree (plus 4 trees elsewhere). A tree cannot feed two. Question: does each pair share, split up, trade or fight, and do the four pairs choose differently? | v2 fix (world only): in S6v1 all four pairs did the same thing: the r2 race loser left and starved blind (4 other trees over 169 tiles), the winner camped and starved later (all 8 dead r35-r55, 0 messages, 0 transfers; a03 attacked its own tree for essence). One tree gave 3.6 compute/round at 30% absorption while one thinking agent spends ~6.3/round, so staying and leaving were both death and there was no real choice. Changes: absorption 0.3 -> 0.5 for everyone (a home tree now nearly feeds one agent but not two); starting compute 120 -> 180; map 13x13 -> 11x11 with pairs at (+-3,+-3), vision 2 -> 3 and communication 3 -> 4 so a pair member who leaves can find the other trees and neighbours. Thinking price (~4.3), tree count (8), fruit and persona unchanged.
